coordinates.locator: geometry:modane-lsm-underground (OpenStreetMap-georeferenced underground laboratory point, accuracy 100 m)
coordinates.note: Point for the laboratory inside the Fréjus tunnel, georeferenced from OpenStreetMap; it is shown as approximate because an OpenStreetMap tracing is not a survey. It replaces the Carré Sciences surface outreach building in Modane, 6.4 km from the laboratory.

summary.plain: A laboratory carved into the rock in the middle of a road tunnel through the Alps, under 1700 metres of mountain, near Modane, France.
summary.technical: Underground experimental hall mid-way through the Frejus road tunnel (Modane, Savoie), under ~1700 m of rock; address Carre Sciences, 1125 route de Bardonneche, 73500 Modane.
